name: claude-model-router
description: Model routing for Claude Code: delegate bulk reads and boilerplate generation to a cheap worker model, and measure what it saved.

plugins.name: model-router
plugins.description: Keeps Claude as the primary reasoning agent while shunting bulk file reading to a cheap worker model. A PreToolUse hook gates large reads, the gate fails open so a broken worker degrades to plain Claude Code, and every delegation is measured. Slash commands expose the diagnostic and the report.

plugins.name: router-dashboard
plugins.description: Renders a model-router analytics response as a self-contained HTML report: delegation rate, worker usage, tokens avoided, estimated savings and their measurement coverage, latency, governance decisions and data quality. Read-only, and it never recomputes cost.
